name: Li Chia
bio: Li Chia (李甲; Li Jia; fl. c. 1100) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 帝台春 (Di tai chun)
poems.author: Li Chia
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
芳草碧色，萋萋遍南陌。
暖絮乱红，也知人、春愁无力。
忆得盈盈拾翠侣，共携赏、凤城寒食。
到今来，海角逢春，天涯为客。
愁旋释。
还似织。
泪暗拭。
又偷滴。
谩伫立、遍倚危阑，尽黄昏，也只是、暮云凝碧。
拼则而已今拼了，忘则怎生便忘得。
又还问鳞鸿，试重寻消息。
